about: Modwerk source-only ctrl-all package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/ctrl-all.

mods.title: Ctrl All
mods.summary: Hold TRK and turn a knob on a sound or TRIG page: the same step goes to that parameter on all twelve sound tracks.
mods.description: Ctrl All turns TRK into an all-tracks modifier. Hold TRK and turn a knob on a sound page (SYNTH, SAMPLE, FILTER, AMP, LFO) or the TRIG page, and the same step goes to that parameter on all twelve sound tracks, so their differences are kept and each track stops at its own limits. On the SYNTH page each track moves the parameter under the same knob of its own machine's page. FILTER TYP sets every track to the type the selected track reaches. With the FX track selected, while a trig key is held, or on FX and global pages, the knob behaves as stock. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0014-ctrl-all 1.2, with his code unchanged.
mods.author: Iced-Cream
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported by the author: its tests passed in builds R8K4 and C3A4 beside other rytm2_mods ports; in SXH4, beside the other five Modwerk submissions, and in CAH4, alone, TRK + FRQ moved several tracks together and the FX track changed alone. All four used core-ar2 0.3 or earlier. This package's own bytes have not been flashed from the site.
